Thanks for your reports! We did report this issue to the development team but any additional information will help so please send a ticket to our Customer Support team and attach a dxdiag.txt once you made sure no background programs are causing this awkward behavior.

Issue Description:
After choosing a channel to join, I got into a Team Battle game. After I got out, my character (in the avatar view) was overlapped with another character. I could rotate my own character, but it was still obstructed by this other character.

Steps to reproduce:
Right after getting out of a game.

Expected Behavior:
There shouldn't be multiple characters in the avatar view, especially when they obstruct my own character.

Version:
BrickForce ver 1.6 Infernum Release: 62

Attached are in-game screenshots of the issue.
